sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Craymeleon: A chameleon-crayfish river beast with bright shell plates and independently swiveling eyes, often harnessed to pull small boats through glowing current.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use as a moral encounter. Reward restraint and observation without forcing a pet or mascot outcome.
